name: – Motion for a resolution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary detention of President Mohamed Bazoum by the junta in Niger
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the immediate release of Niger's elected president, Mohamed Bazoum, and his wife. They have been held by the military junta since the 2023 coup, reportedly without lawyers, family visits or proper medical care, and he could face the death penalty. The Parliament also condemns the junta's crackdown on journalists, political parties and civil society, and urges a return to democratic elections. It asks the European Union and other international bodies to push diplomatically for the couple's release.

- The Parliament demands the release of President Bazoum and his wife; the junta holding them is affected.
- It calls on the European Union, African Union and others to step up diplomacy to secure that release.
- It urges Niger's authorities to restore democratic order and hold free elections; no deadline is set.
